results.title: Anderson County Joins South Carolina Counties Halting Data Center Approvals
results.description: Anderson County, SC approved a six-month data center moratorium, joining York, Newberry and other counties pausing new projects in 2026.

results.title: ‘From crisis management to stability’: Pashinyan unveils new government programme
results.description: Armenia's Cabinet approves 2026–2031 programme: Pashinyan explains what to expect over the next five years and outlines the government's foreign policy priorities
